edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest the direction is more reliable than any single pooled magnitude.
edges.mechanism: This drug-related edge is biologically plausible because the medication changes absorption, excretion, endocrine signaling, or tissue turnover in a predictable direction. Duration, dose, and co-medication use usually determine whether the effect becomes clinically relevant for Vitamin B6 status.
edges.summary: Combined oral contraceptive use appears tied to adverse shifts in vitamin b6 status in premenopausal women using oral contraceptives mainly through pooled meta-analytic evidence. The likely magnitude is modest, which is why the edge is framed conservatively rather than as a headline-level breakthrough.
edges.caveats: Medication benefits may still outweigh this risk. The practical implication is usually monitoring, dosing separation, or targeted supplementation rather than indiscriminate discontinuation.
